changelog:
Initial release — provides automation for managing and completing repository TODO items.

- Processes TODO items under the "Current" header in TODO.md, applying updates as instructed.
- Updates documentation, CHANGELOG.md, and manifest files based on completed TODOs and specified version increments.
- Maintains a current road map in .github/current.roadmap.md, ensuring TODO item compatibility and order.
- Bundles scripts/todo.mjs to archive completed TODO items to a "Complete" section in TODO.md.
- Handles testing and rollback logic; restores files if automated updates fail.
summary: Complete TODO.md items nested under the level 2 header "Current", then update documentation, CHANGELOG.md, and manifest files according to the version update each item indicates.
